items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about old Alfonso Trent? Did you ever hear him? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Trent's band. They was around Texas.

ctx.x: No. You see, those boys, they were from all out of the East. Well West played with them for a while. And nobody from here, how I got the job is through Victor Spencer. When Victor Spencer was taking so many hands and so, you know, you understand me? I didn't want to come this way. Well I got into Charlie Christian. I liked his style because he played on it. You know, all the styles. That's the guy. You ever heard that record with Lionel Hampton guys? All them kind of numbers like that. Well I wanted to be around…
What about old Alfonso Trent? Did you ever hear him? Trent's band? Trent's band. They played around Texas.

Yeah, Trent's band. They was around Texas. Well Boots and his brothers and Trent's and all of them, well he used to tie up there in Orange and around Houston, he used to be around Houston a lot. Well with all them bands, he had big bands too. Yeah. And with them bands, they was like a socialite, or a real orchestra, you understand, on that music key, you understand. Well what about Alvin Walls, was that a socialite kind of band? Well it's mostly a dance band, and you know, on the cocktail side, soft music. Well…
